cases.title: Acute Asthma Exacerbation with Upper Respiratory Triggers
T2DM Glycemic Control & Peripheral Neuropathy Assessment

pastHistory.lifestyleNotes: Active school day, uses inhaler intermittently

familyHistory: Both parents: Ischemic heart disease, diabetes

visits.currentComplaint: Bilateral pressing headache radiating to occiput for 2 days; exacerbated by computer screen work.
visits.examinationNotes: Neck muscle spasm noted. Fundoscopy normal. No focal neurological deficits.

followUp.clinicalInstructions: Return if headache worsens or does not resolve in 5 days.

visits.preliminaryDiagnosis: Episodic Tension-Type Headache with Cervicogenic Component

prescription.clinicalCounseling: Ensure adequate hydration and regular breaks from screen work.

items.instructions: Take with plenty of water after food. Do not exceed 4g/day.
items.name: Paracetamol

prescription.patientInstructions: Rest in a quiet, dark room if headache escalates.

visits.treatmentAdvice: Ergonomic screen adjustments, hydration, neck stretching exercises.

visits.currentComplaint: Dry persistent cough for 4 days, chest tightness and nocturnal wheezing waking her up.
visits.examinationNotes: Bilateral expiratory wheezes on auscultation. Prolonged expiratory phase. No intercostal retraction.
visits.finalDiagnosis: Acute Asthma Bronchospasm triggered by viral upper respiratory tract infection

followUp.clinicalInstructions: Re-evaluate peak expiratory flow and resolution of wheeze.

investigations.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential
investigations.notes: Check for eosinophilia and infective leukocytosis

investigations.name: Chest X-Ray PA View
investigations.notes: Evaluate for focal infiltrates or hyperinflation

prescription.clinicalCounseling: Strict demonstration of proper metered-dose inhaler inhalation technique provided.

items.instructions: Use spacer if available. Rinse mouth after use.
items.name: Salbutamol Inhaler

items.instructions: Maintain daily adherence. Rinse mouth thoroughly.
items.name: Budesonide / Formoterol

prescription.patientInstructions: Seek urgent medical attention if chest tightness fails to respond to 4 puffs of Salbutamol within 15 minutes.

visits.treatmentAdvice: Avoid dust and strong perfumes. Steam inhalation twice daily.

visits.currentComplaint: Initial workup for suboptimal glycemic readings and bilateral burning sensations in toes.
visits.examinationNotes: Monofilament test reveals diminished sensation on distal 1st and 5th metatarsal heads.
visits.finalDiagnosis: Uncontrolled T2DM with Early Symmetrical Distal Sensory Neuropathy

followUp.clinicalInstructions: Return on 2026-09-22 with laboratory blood results and glucose log.

visits.operationalContext: Initial encounter for diabetic review and foot symptoms
visits.preliminaryDiagnosis: Type 2 Diabetes with Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy

prescription.clinicalCounseling: Comprehensive dietary review for low glycemic load carbohydrates conducted.

items.instructions: Take during or immediately after meals to reduce GI distress.
items.name: Metformin HCl

items.frequency: Once daily on an empty stomach
items.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid

prescription.patientInstructions: Record fasting and 2-hour postprandial glucose in logbook.

visits.treatmentAdvice: Diabetic foot care education, inspect feet daily, wear protective footwear.

visits.currentComplaint: Follow-up review with laboratory reports: Fasting glucose 142 mg/dL, HbA1c 7.4%. Tingling slightly improved.
visits.examinationNotes: Repeat neurological check shows stable sensation. Peripheral pulses palpable and symmetric.
visits.finalDiagnosis: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with satisfactory treatment response

followUp.clinicalInstructions: Repeat HbA1c in 3 months and check renal function tests.

visits.operationalContext: Recorded Visit — follow-up continuity; previous Visits remain preserved
visits.preliminaryDiagnosis: T2DM under medical optimization; resolving neuropathic burning.

prescription.clinicalCounseling: Patient encouraged by improvement. Re-emphasized smoking cessation maintenance.

items.instructions: Swallow whole with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew.
items.name: Metformin HCl (Extended Release)

prescription.patientInstructions: Continue home glucometer check twice weekly.

visits.treatmentAdvice: Continue Mediterranean diet regimen. Aim for 30 minutes brisk walking daily.
